description: Get one credit note (Gutschrift) by its sevDesk id with its positions (name, quantity, unit, unit price net/gross, tax rate, sums), totals (net, Umsatzsteuer, gross), tax rule (Steuerregel), booking category, the invoice or voucher it refers to (sourceInvoiceId, sourceVoucherId), recipient address and delivery date. Use it after sevdesk_credit_notes_list; open the source invoice with sevdesk_invoice_get.

id.description: Credit note id (not its number), e.g. from sevdesk_credit_notes_list.

name: sevdesk_credit_note_get
title: Get a sevDesk credit note
